rules.content:
title: DPRK IT Worker Resume Geographic Mismatch
status: experimental
description: Detects job applicants whose resume combines a U.S. residential address with education credentials from non-North American institutions (Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, China, South Korea). This pattern 
logsource:
    product: hr_platform
    service: applicant_tracking
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "application_submitted"
        address_country: "US"
    filter_education:
        education_country|contains:
            - "SG"
            - "JP"
            - "HK"
            - "CN"
            - "KR"
            - "IN"
            - "MY"
    filter_thin_profile:
        linkedin_age_days|lt: 365
    condition: selection and filter_education and filter_thin_profile
level: medium
rules.title: DL-0068: DPRK IT Worker Resume Geographic Mismatch (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: VPN/Proxy Login Anomaly — Astrill or Residential Proxy
status: experimental
description: Detects corporate VPN authentication events originating from known Astrill VPN infrastructure, residential proxy services, or connection patterns indicating VPN-over-VPN layering. DPRK IT workers rout
logsource:
    product: vpn
    service: authentication
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "vpn_auth_success"
    filter_astrill:
        src_ip_vpn_provider: "Astrill"
    filter_residential_proxy:
        src_ip_type: "residential_proxy"
    filter_vpn_layering:
        connection_hops|gte: 3
        src_ip_type|contains:
            - "vpn"
            - "proxy"
    condition: selection and (filter_astrill or filter_residential_proxy or filter_vpn_layering)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0069: VPN/Proxy Login Anomaly — Astrill or Residential Proxy (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Multi-Operator Behavioral Shift — Timezone and Communication Anomaly")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct src_timezone) by user_id > 2")`
index=flame_identity sourcetype=flame:authentication event_type="user_login"
| stats dc(src_timezone) as unique_src_timezone by user_id
| where unique_src_timezone > 2
rules.title: DL-0070: Multi-Operator Behavioral Shift — Timezone and Communication Anomaly (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Bulk Code Repository Clone by New Employee
status: experimental
description: Detects a new employee (within first 14 days of onboarding) cloning or downloading multiple code repositories, especially repositories outside their assigned team or project scope. DPRK IT workers fre
logsource:
    product: git_platform
    service: audit_log
detection:
    selection:
        action|contains:
            - "repo.clone"
            - "repo.download"
            - "repo.fork"
        actor_account_age_days|lte: 14
    filter_volume:
        repos_cloned_24h|gte: 5
    filter_out_of_scope:
        repo_team_match: false
    condition: selection and (filter_volume or filter_out_of_scope)
level: high
rules.title: DL-0071: Bulk Code Repository Clone by New Employee (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Credential Store Access Anomaly During Onboarding
status: experimental
description: Detects new employees accessing browser credential stores, password managers, API key management systems, or SSO session token stores at rates significantly above peer baselines during the first 14 da
logsource:
    product: endpoint
    service: edr
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "credential_store_access"
            - "password_manager_export"
            - "session_token_read"
            - "api_key_create"
        user_tenure_days|lte: 14
    filter_volume:
        credential_access_count_24h|gte: 10
    condition: selection and filter_volume
level: high
rules.title: DL-0072: Credential Store Access Anomaly During Onboarding (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Salary Direct Deposit Rapid Cryptocurrency Conversion")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_deposit | near selection_conversion")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
transaction_type="ACH_IN"
transaction_category="payroll"
(outbound_type="crypto_exchange" OR outbound_type="p2p_crypto" OR outbound_type="wire_to_exchange")
time_since_deposit_hours<=48
| transaction account_id maxspan=1h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0073: Salary Direct Deposit Rapid Cryptocurrency Conversion (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Post-Termination Data Extortion Indicator
status: experimental
description: Detects indicators of post-termination data extortion, where a recently terminated or resigned employee communicates ransom demands referencing specific internal proprietary code, documents, or trade 
logsource:
    product: security_operations
    service: incident_management
detection:
    selection:
        event_type|contains:
            - "extortion_communication"
            - "data_leak_detected"
            - "proprietary_code_public"
        actor_employment_status: "terminated"
        actor_termination_days|lte: 90
    condition: selection
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0074: Post-Termination Data Extortion Indicator (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Real-Time Face/Voice Changer Detection During Video Interview")`
`comment("Native query required - audio/video analysis cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
index=flame_collaboration sourcetype=flame:video_conferencing
(camera_driver_name="*OBS Virtual*" OR camera_driver_name="*ManyCam*" OR camera_driver_name="*DeepFace*" OR camera_driver_name="*FaceSwap*")
OR audio_analysis_score>0.75
OR lip_sync_delta_ms>200
| eval risk_score=case(
    camera_driver_name LIKE "%DeepFace%" OR camera_driver_name LIKE "%FaceSwap%", 90,
    camera_driver_name LIKE "%OBS Virtual%" OR camera_driver_name LIKE "%ManyCam%", 50,
    audio_analysis_score>0.75, 80,
    lip_sync_delta_ms>200, 70)
| where risk_score>=50
| stats count values(camera_driver_name) as cameras values(audio_analysis_score) as audio_scores max(lip_sync_delta_ms) as max_lip_delta by user_id session_id
rules.title: DL-0116: Real-Time Face/Voice Changer Detection During Video Interview (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect automated circumvention of KYC identity verification processes: (1) liveness check submissions exhibiting synthetic face indicators such as GAN artifacts or uniform skin texture, (2) document p
logsource:
    product: banking
    category: identity_verification
    service: kyc_verification
detection:
    selection_synthetic:
        liveness_synthetic_score|gt: 0.7
    selection_lighting:
        document_lighting_mismatch: true
        selfie_lighting_mismatch: true
    selection_multi_ip:
        identity_multi_ip_count|gt: 2
        ip_geo_dispersion_km|gt: 500
    selection_automation:
        session_interaction_pattern: "automated"
        verification_attempt_count|gte: 3
    condition: selection_synthetic or selection_lighting or selection_multi_ip or selection_automation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0119: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: DPRK Internal Platform Network Connection Detection
status: experimental
description: Detect connections to DPRK-associated internal collaboration platforms OConnect VPN and NetKey VPN, identified by Flare and IBM X-Force as tools used by DPRK IT workers: (1) VPN connections to known O
logsource:
    product: network
    category: network_connection
    service: vpn_monitoring
detection:
    selection_vpn_product:
        vpn_product|contains:
            - "OConnect"
            - "NetKey"
    selection_dns:
        dns_query|contains:
            - "oconnect"
            - "netkey"
            - "oconnect.net"
            - "netkey.io"
    selection_dual_vpn:
        concurrent_vpn_connections|gte: 2
        corporate_vpn_active: true
        external_vpn_detected: true
    condition: selection_vpn_product or selection_dns or selection_dual_vpn
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0121: DPRK Internal Platform Network Connection Detection (Sigma)
